text:
alex: Heads up — seeing a 15-25% tail-latency regression on Llama-13B-mixtral (hosted) for requests with seq_len > 8k after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. Noticed more CPU memcpy and kernel fallback churn. Should we roll back?
perf-bot: Automated profile summary attached: p95 up 22%, p99 up 28% on long-context workload. Kernel selection changed at commit 7a3f2d -> favoring fused_attn_v3 for short seqs, but falling back to generic_attn for long seqs.
mira: Oof. I started a quick perf capture: `nsys profile --sample=none --capture-range=nvtx` and grabbed a 30s window from the failed run. Raw shows lots of `cudaMemcpyAsync` spikes around token 6k-9k.
sam: Can you paste the minimal repro (model config + request pattern)? I can bisect kernel selector commit.
mira: Repro: model=llama-13b-mixtral, batch_sizes=[1,2,4,8], context_lengths=[2048,4096,8192,12288], tokenizer=sentencepiece, quant=8bit. Script: ```python
# run_sweep.py (snippet)
for b in [1,2,4,8]:
  for L in [2048,4096,8192,12288]:
    cli.run('--model llama-13b-mixtral --batch', b, '--seq', L)
```
kai: Preliminary root cause hypothesis: kernel selector introduced a length-bucket cutoff that triggers a slower attention path for mixed-head/kv dims in Mixtral. RoPE scaling and fractional heads cause stride mismatch, so we fall back to non-optimized kernel.
ajordan: Did we change any quant/kernel compatibility matrix? Might be a small boolean flip.
perf-bot: Diff of selector: +case when seq_len <= 4096 -> fused_attn_v3; else -> generic_attn (previously had intermediate path fused_attn_v2 for 4096-12288).
amend: (bot typo)
alex: Two options: 1) roll back selector commit (quick but may lose some short-seq gains), 2) ship targeted fix: re-enable fused_attn_v2 for mixtral family and adjust rope-scaling guard. Thoughts?
sam: I'll bisect today. If we can localize to selector logic, we can push a micro-patch that gates based on model family and head/kv dims: `if model.family == 'mixtral' and heads%4 != 0: prefer fused_attn_v2`
mira: From the profile, KV cache eviction rate spikes at token ~9k. We might be thrashing the KV cache layer due to stride change: `kv_cache.write` shows heavy unaligned writes. Suspect quantized layout + RoPE fractional leads to extra memcpy to reformat.
kai: Short-term mitigation for hosted: add per-model runtime override in config: { "kernel_override": "fused_attn_v2", "max_batch_for_long_ctx": 4, "kv_eviction_threshold": 0.7 } — can push via remote config for affected customers.
jordan: Also recommend adding a console alert: when p95 > baseline*1.15 for long-context route, create incident.
perf-bot: Quick benchmark results (30s each):
```
model: llama-13b-mixtral
seq=4096 bs=8  p95=120ms
seq=8192 bs=4  p95=210ms (regressed from 170ms)
seq=12288 bs=2 p95=430ms (regressed from 340ms)
```
These are from prod-like infra.
alex: Good data. Sam — if bisect narrows to selector change, can you craft a patch that restores fused_attn_v2 for mixtral and adds a unit test that asserts chosen kernel for (seq=8192, heads=32, kv_dim=128)?
sam: Yep. Also will add a micro-benchmark in CI: `./tools/perf_check --model mixtral --seq 8192 --batch 4` to prevent regressions.
mira: For longer term, we should: 1) instrument kernel selector with decision reason tags in traces, 2) add a RoPE-aware alignment pass that avoids extra copies, 3) expand quant/kernel compatibility matrix.
kai: I'll open a remote-config change for emergency mitigation: set runtime override for the mixtral 13B model to fused_attn_v2 and cap batch sizes for >8k contexts. Rolling to prod can be done in ~20m.
alex: Sounds good. If infra-bot and perf-bot confirm rollback risk low, proceed with override. Keep rollback PR ready.
perf-bot: Patch candidate created: `pr/1824` with selector tweak + unit test. CI micro-bench queued.
infra-bot: Remote-config rollout started to 10% of hosts for mixtral-13b long-ctx route.
jordan: After rollout, run a 24h sweep and add automated alerting to Redwood Console for this route. Include token-level cost delta too.
alex: Thanks team. Sam/mira coordinate on bisect and patch. Kai, please monitor alerting and ramp up config if stable. :thumbsup:
mira: I'll upload the nsys trace and a short flame graph to the thread in ~30m.
sam: Bisect started (job id 4382). Will report back with commit range.
perf-bot: NOTE: Added a dashboard panel: "mixtral-13b long-ctx kernel picks".
alex: Closing the chat here — follow ups in PR/issue. Good work.
